ADR-001 (Accepted) specifies a third dependency kind, `verifies`, plus a structural advisor that reports a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead — with measured field evidence (21 and 24 inverted gates in two live workspaces) that the error class is real and recurring. Implement the edge kind in schema and validation (cycle rejection unchanged), report the diagnosis in doctor output, keep it strictly advisory (never reject at insert), add no title-based inference, extend the field guide and JSON Schema, and cover the new edge kind with concurrency and checkpoint round-trip tests.

issue.description:
Auto-split child of beadrs-5a0dc962; depends on build-from-archive.sh existing.

Add a test that asserts a pinned-binary build leaves the shared checkout untouched — the acceptance the parent states directly: git stash list and git reflog are unchanged by a run.

Scope:
- Capture git stash list and git reflog before and after invoking scripts/build-from-archive.sh for a real pinned sha, and assert equality.
- Wire it into the existing test suite or a scripts check target so it runs by default, with an env var pointing at the repo under test (no hardcoded paths).
- Also assert git status --porcelain is empty after a run, so no staged or unstaged changes leak into the shared tree.

Acceptance:
- Test passes on a clean run of the script.
- Negative control: a variant that mutates the shared checkout (a scripted git stash injection behind a test-only flag) makes the test fail, proving the assertion has teeth.

Parent: beadrs-5a0dc962.
issue.title: Add an invariant test asserting pinned-binary builds leave the shared checkout untouched
